content.rendered:
• FAST TREATMENTS: Use for just 30 mins every other day, completely portable for an on the go lifestyle.
  • FDA-CLEARED: Peace of mind knowing your Kiierr Laser Cap is safe & effective.
  • DOCTOR RECOMMENDED: The Kiierr 272 Premier Laser Hair Cap is loved by physicians and used in doctor’s offices and hair restoration clinics across the USA.
  • 7-MONTH GROWTH GUARANTEE: With over 93% success rate in clinical studies, what are you waiting for? If you do not receive thicker, fuller hair after 7 months, you may send it back for a refund (see return policy for details).

Kiierr 272 Premier Max Growth Bundle Includes:

  • 272 Diode – Laser Helmet
  • Plain Black Ball Cap (wear your laser cap anywhere)
  • Wall Charger, USB Cord & Power Pack
  • User Manual & FAQ’s Guide
  • Kiierr Hair Growth Bundle (shampoo, conditioner & vitamins) 
  • Biotin Gummies for Hair Growth 

 

Kiierr 272 Premier Laser Hair Cap – Affordable, Effective, and Safe

The Kiierr 272 Premier laser cap is one of the most affordable, effective, and safe hair growth remedies. It helps you tackle the problems of thinning and balding hair, hair loss, and frail hair from the comfort of your home, and in a cost and time-efficient manner while you’re enjoying your favorite activities such as, reading a book, watching TV, gardening, cooking … and the list goes on. It’s safe even if you fall asleep while wearing the cap, in which case it will automatically turn off. For added safety, the cap includes a programmed sensor technology that shuts it off if it falls off your head.

The Science Behind LLLT & the Kiierr 272 Premier Laser Hair Cap

The science behind the LLLT technology is that by virtue of a process called photo-biotherapy, cells absorb the low-level light emitted from the laser, which stimulates their metabolism and protein synthesis. These processes in turn stimulate the hair follicles, thereby promoting hair growth and reducing hair loss.

Scientific studies have proved that the LLLT technology results in thicker and healthier hair. Both the studies and governing certifications have attested to the safety and effectiveness of this technology. Regardless of whether you’ll be using the Kiierr 272 Premier laser hair cap as a stand-alone remedy or in combination with topical foams, prescription medications, and hair transplant surgeries, it’s an effective treatment for hair loss. In fact, all Kiierr LLLT devices are FDA-cleared for promotion of hair growth and reduction of hair loss in adults with androgenetic alopecia. With the help of safe, low-level lasers, the 272 Premier laser cap energizes hair follicles and spurs new, natural hair growth.
